heading.en: Why doesn't the nucleus fly apart?

hook.en: Protons a femtometre apart repel each other with a force of a couple of hundred newtons, enough to lift a child. Something far stronger holds them together.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಫೆಮ್ಟೋಮೀಟರ್ ಅಂತರದ ಪ್ರೋಟಾನ್‌ಗಳು ನೂರಾರು ನ್ಯೂಟನ್ ಬಲದಿಂದ ವಿಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಬಲವಾದ ಬಲ ಅವನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿಟ್ಟಿದೆ.

objectives.en: List the properties of the nuclear force
Explain the saturation of binding energy

narration.en: Protons a femtometre apart repel each other with a force of a couple of hundred newtons, enough to lift a child. Something far stronger holds them together.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಫೆಮ್ಟೋಮೀಟರ್ ಅಂತರದ ಪ್ರೋಟಾನ್‌ಗಳು ನೂರಾರು ನ್ಯೂಟನ್ ಬಲದಿಂದ ವಿಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಬಲವಾದ ಬಲ ಅವನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿಟ್ಟಿದೆ.

body.en: The nuclear force is much stronger than the Coulomb force. It is short-range: it falls to almost zero beyond a few femtometres. It is attractive for separations above about 0.8 fm and strongly repulsive closer than that. It is nearly the same between neutron–neutron, proton–neutron and proton–proton pairs: it is charge independent. It has no simple mathematical form like Coulomb's law.
body.kn: ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯರ್ ಬಲ ಕೂಲಂಬ್ ಬಲಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಬಲ, ಅಲ್ಪ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯದು, ಆವೇಶ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ. ಸುಮಾರು 0.8 fm ಗಿಂತ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಕರ್ಷಕ, ಹತ್ತಿರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಕರ್ಷಕ.

points.en: Strongest of the forces in the nucleus

narration.en: The nuclear force is much stronger than the Coulomb force. It is short-range: it falls to almost zero beyond a few femtometres. It is attractive for separations above about 0.8 fm and strongly repulsive closer than that. It is nearly the same between neutron–neutron, proton–neutron and proton–proton pairs: it is charge independent. It has no simple mathematical form like Coulomb's law.

narration.en: Let us draw the potential energy of two nucleons and list what makes the nuclear force special.

say.en: Potential energy of two nucleons against their separation: strongly repulsive when closer than about 0.8 fm, attractive just beyond, and nearly zero after a few fm.
So the force is repulsive inside 0.8 fm, strongly attractive near 1 fm, and negligible beyond about 3 fm.
It is the strongest force in nature, but short-ranged. It is the same between any pair of nucleons, and each nucleon binds only its neighbours.
Compared with it, electromagnetism is about a hundred times weaker and gravity is utterly negligible. Two protons 1 fm apart repel with only 1.44 MeV of Coulomb energy.

text.en: Two protons at 1 fm: Coulomb 1.44 MeV

body.en: Because the force is short-range, a nucleon in a large nucleus is bound only to its nearest neighbours. Adding more nucleons does not bind each one more strongly, so the binding energy per nucleon stays nearly constant for medium-mass nuclei.
body.kn: ಬಲ ಅಲ್ಪ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯದ್ದಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಪ್ರತಿ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಾನ್ ತನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಿರದ ನೆರೆಯವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಂಧಿತ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್‌ಗಳ ಪ್ರತಿ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಾನ್ ಬಂಧನ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಸ್ಥಿರ.
